claims.text: The authors compare MERF against existing application-specific techniques including ANGE, ATEEMA, GENTREE, and NUMNORM.
MERF is compared to SystemT, which uses an algebraic approach to information extraction and aims to overcome limitations of CPSL.
The authors also compare MERF with TEXTMARKER, a semi-automatic rule-based information extraction system.
